# Lensmor API Documentation

> Customer-facing Lensmor Event Intelligence API documentation for event discovery, exhibitor research, personnel lookup, credits, and profile matching.

## Primary Resources

- [Full documentation export](https://api.lensmor.com/llms-full.txt)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://api.lensmor.com/openapi.json)
- [API catalog](https://api.lensmor.com/api-catalog.json)

## API Base URL

`https://platform.lensmor.com`

All public API paths are under `/external/*` and require `Authorization: Bearer uak_your_api_key`.
